STEP 7. Check the harness wires between combination 
meter connector C-42 and fusible link (2).
NOTE: After checking junction block connectors C-104 and C-
110 and intermediate connector C-89, check the wires. If 
junction block connectors C-104 and C-110 and intermediate 
connector C-89 are damaged, repair or replace them. Refer to 
GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
Q: Are the harness wires between combination meter 
connector C-42 and fusible link (2) in good condition?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Repair or replace them. The high-beam indicator light 
should work normally.
